{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or neutral and historical price trends show mean reversion.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes when sentiment is positive, to avoid undershooting.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude if model overestimates after a sharp upward move (overshoot correction).",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast, adjust next period’s forecast upward by 10-15% of the gap.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending upward, add a 5-10% buffer to forecast to account for momentum.",
    "If sentiment is negative and price is trending downward, reduce forecast by 5-10% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "Use recent 7-day average as a baseline for smoothing out short-term volatility in forecasts.",
    "For high sentiment volatility, apply a dampening factor to prevent erratic forecast swings."
  ]
}
